title: Welding.
officialText:
Welding on pressure vessels shall be performed by welders certified in compliance with nationally recognized
standards, ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section IX; 12 NYCRR 4-6.2; and 12 NYCRR 14-3.3 through 14-3.18.
SECTION MC 1004
BOILERS
